parameters.name: OrderColumn
parameters.description:
The sort column when the response contains multiple DTS dedicated cluster instances. Valid values:

- **gmtCreated**: creation time.
- **orderCount**: number of nodes.

parameters.name: OrderDirection
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order. This is the default value.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of clusters to display per page.

parameters.name: Params
parameters.description:
The specific content of the query condition.

> You must first specify the **Type** parameter to define the query key.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is used as a query condition.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The cluster status. Valid values:

- **init**: initializing.
- **schedule**: pending scheduling.
- **running**: running.
- **upgrade**: upgrading.
- **downgrade**: downgrading.
- **locked**: locked.
- **releasing**: being released.
- **released**: released.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The query key. Valid values:

- **NAME**: cluster name.
- **INSTANCE**: cluster instance ID.
- **DEDICATEDCLUSTERID**: dedicated cluster ID.

> You must also specify the **Params** parameter to provide the specific content of the query condition.
